paper.title_en: Thermodynamic stability and geometric thermodynamics of charged black holes in Rastall-massive gravity under quintessence
paper.abstract_en: In the present paper, we derive a new charged black hole solution embedded in a quintessence field within a framework combining the Rastall and massive gravity in an asymptotically flat spacetime. We interpret the integration constant associated with the structural properties of the quintessence field as a thermodynamical variable. In this context, several limiting cases have been explored with the aim to shed light on the role of the model parameters. Then, we analyse the thermodynamic properties and stability of the charged black holes in flat spacetime, where the quintessence field is characterized by the state parameter \( ω_q = -2/3 \). Detailed studies are perfomed to see how the various parameters affect phase transitions between small and large black holes. In particular, we establish a connection between the impact parameter and unstable circular photon orbits with the thermodynamic phase transitions. Our analysis suggest that the photon sphere observables could remarkably provide an indirect observational signature of black hole thermodynamic critical transitions. Generally, thanks to the effective contribution of the quintessence parameter, we found that the overall thermodynamic behavior basically resembles that of the charged RN--AdS black hole with thermal features analogous to of a Van der Waals fluid ones. Finally, we have checked these findings using thermodynamic geometry with the Quevedo metric. Our results showed that the critical behaviour derived from the standard thermodynamics is fully consistent with geothermodynamics description, where the phase structure and divergence points exactly coincide with those identified from heat capacity and Gibbs free energy analyses.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了一个新的带电黑洞解，并对其热力学稳定性、相变和几何热力学进行了详细分析，与光子球观测相关联，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 昆特森背景下Rastall-大质量引力中带电黑洞的热力学稳定性与几何热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们在渐近平坦时空中，结合Rastall和大质量引力的框架下，推导了一个嵌入昆特森场的新的带电黑洞解。我们将与昆特森场结构性质相关的积分常数解释为一个热力学变量。在此背景下，我们探讨了几个极限情况，以阐明模型参数的作用。然后，我们分析了平坦时空中带电黑洞的热力学性质和稳定性，其中昆特森场由状态参数 \( ω_q = -2/3 \) 表征。我们进行了详细的研究，以了解各种参数如何影响小黑洞和大黑洞之间的相变。特别地，我们建立了碰撞参数和不稳定圆形光子轨道与热力学相变之间的联系。我们的分析表明，光子球可观测量可以显著地提供黑洞热力学临界转变的间接观测特征。总的来说，得益于昆特森参数的有效贡献，我们发现整体热力学行为基本上类似于带电RN--AdS黑洞，其热特征类似于范德瓦尔斯流体。最后，我们使用Quevedo度量通过热力学几何验证了这些发现。我们的结果表明，从标准热力学推导出的临界行为与地热力学描述完全一致，相结构和发散点与热容和吉布斯自由能分析所识别的完全吻合。
